title: Chinese People Addicted to Eating
synopsis: They say the Chinese love to eat anything, but just how much is the concept of eating a part of Chinese society?

fullText.simplified:
中国人到底有多爱吃？

    都说中国人爱吃，天上飞的，地上走的，水里游的，能吃的都吃了。中国人到底有多爱吃呢？
    对于吃，有人说中国人什么事情都爱用吃来形容：工作不叫工作，叫饭碗；开除不叫开除，叫炒鱿鱼；嫉妒叫吃醋；占便宜叫吃豆腐；被起诉叫吃官司；拿人好处叫吃回扣；没遇着人叫吃闭门羹；就连没钱了都想着用吃土来形容。
    的确，在中国，熟人见面，说的第一句话不是“你好”，而是“你吃饭了吗”？中午吃什么，晚上吃什么，可以算是国民难题。甚至有人说，中国的英文“China”也是很有深意的，因为它也叫“chi na（吃哪）”。
    你说中国人是不是很爱吃？
fullText.traditional:
中國人到底有多愛吃？

    都說中國人愛吃，天上飛的，地上走的，水裡游的，能吃的都吃了。中國人到底有多愛吃呢？
    對於吃，有人說中國人什麼事情都愛用吃來形容：工作不叫工作，叫飯碗；開除不叫開除，叫炒魷魚；嫉妒叫吃醋；佔便宜叫吃豆腐；被起訴叫吃官司；拿人好處叫吃回扣；沒遇著人叫吃閉門羹；就連沒錢了都想著用吃土來形容。
    的確，在中國，熟人見面，說的第一句話不是“你好”，而是“你吃飯了嗎”？中午吃什麼，晚上吃什麼，可以算是國民難題。甚至有人說，中國的英文“China”也是很有深意的，因為它也叫“chi na（吃哪）”。
    你說中國人是不是很愛吃？

raw.synopsis: They say the Chinese love to eat anything, but just how much is the concept of eating a part of Chinese society?
sentence_translations: How addicted are Chinese people to eating?
They say the Chinese love to eat so much they eat all that flies in the sky, walks on the earth and swims in the water.
So, how addicted are Chinese people to eating?
Some say the Chinese relate everything in life to eating:
A job is called a rice bowl;
To fire someone is called “to fry their squid”;
To be jealous is called “drinking vinegar”;
Taking advantage of a woman is called “to eat tofu”;
To be sued is called “to eat a lawsuit”;
To accept a bribe is called “eating a discount”;
If someone refuses to meet you, it is called a “door-closing soup”;
Having no money is even called “to eat dirt”.
Indeed, the first thing you say when you meet a friend in China is not “how are you?” but “have you eaten yet?”
What to eat for lunch or for dinner is a difficult question for Chinese citizens.
Some even say the English word “China” is interesting because it can be read as “where to eat”.
So tell me: how addicted are Chinese people to eating?
